title: Failover trigger engine
intent: Evaluate heartbeat-loss continuity recipes for managed services and emit exactly one in-process failover request when a primary heartbeat remains expired across two evaluations.
observed_before: Phase 1 domain contracts existed for service continuity profiles, failover recipes, replication policies, and heartbeat observations.
HeartbeatMonitor existed for latest worker heartbeat snapshots, but no definition store or automatic failover evaluator existed.
implemented_behavior: InMemoryContinuityDefinitionStore keeps latest ServiceContinuityProfile, ReplicationPolicy, and ContinuityRecipe definitions by service key using replaceable-event timestamp ordering with deterministic event-id tie breaking.

FailoverTriggerEngine enumerates managed services from the definition store, evaluates heartbeat_loss failover recipes against primary heartbeat snapshots, transitions healthy/suspect/firing/active state, and publishes FailoverRequested or FailoverRequestFailed in-process events.
Automatic failover requires an eligible non-primary replication target and does not auto-recover or emit duplicate requests after a run is firing or active.
scope_boundaries: Nostr serialization, reactor wiring, recipe execution, status read models, DNS cutover, and bootstrap wiring are owned by other Wave 2 agents and were not modified.
